GeneralOriginSqlTemplate:
;WITH XMLNAMESPACES ('http://www.portalfiscal.inf.br/nfe' AS ns)
SELECT TOP 1
    CONVERT(DATETIME, LEFT(Cab.value('(ns:ide/ns:dhEmi/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(30)'), 19), 126) AS dhEmi,
    TRIM(LEFT(
        STUFF(P.infCpl_Raw, 1, PATINDEX('%VIAGEM: %', P.infCpl_Raw) + 7, ''),
        PATINDEX('%[^0-9]%', STUFF(P.infCpl_Raw, 1, PATINDEX('%VIAGEM: %', P.infCpl_Raw) + 7, '')) - 1
    )) AS infCpl_Trip,
    TRIM(SUBSTRING(P.infCpl_Raw, PATINDEX('%Tipo de Ordem: %', P.infCpl_Raw) + 15, PATINDEX('%,%', STUFF(P.infCpl_Raw, 1, PATINDEX('%Tipo de Ordem: %', P.infCpl_Raw) + 15, '')))) AS infCpl_OrderType,
    C.cIDCustomer AS cIDCustomer_DEST_XML
FROM MC1_InvoiceResponseContent IRC WITH (NOLOCK)
CROSS APPLY (SELECT TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(IRC.cContent, 'XML convertido do JSON recebido: ', ''), CHARINDEX('<', REPLACE(IRC.cContent, 'XML convertido do JSON recebido: ', '')), LEN(IRC.cContent)) AS XML) AS XmlDoc) X
CROSS APPLY X.XmlDoc.nodes('/ns:NFe/ns:infNFe') AS T(Cab)
OUTER APPLY Cab.nodes('ns:infAdic') AS A(Adic)
CROSS APPLY (SELECT Adic.value('(ns:infCpl/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') AS infCpl_Raw) P
LEFT JOIN MC1_Customer C WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON C.cIDCompany = IRC.cIDCompany
    AND C.mc1Enabled = 1
    AND (COALESCE(Cab.value('(ns:dest/ns:CNPJ/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(20)'), Cab.value('(ns:dest/ns:CPF/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(20)')) = C.cDocument1
      OR COALESCE(Cab.value('(ns:dest/ns:CNPJ/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(20)'), Cab.value('(ns:dest/ns:CPF/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(20)')) = C.cDocument2)
    AND C.cCustomerName = Cab.value('(ns:dest/ns:xNome/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')
WHERE IRC.cIDCompany = {cIDCompany}
  AND IRC.cIDInvoice = {cIDInvoice}
  AND IRC.cSerie = {cSerie}
  AND IRC.cIDBranchInvoice = {cIDBranchInvoice}
  AND IRC.cContent IS NOT NULL
  AND IRC.cContent NOT LIKE '%error%'
GeneralDestinationSqlTemplate:
SELECT TOP 1
    I.dEmission,
    I.cIDTrip AS cIDTrip_Invoice,
    I.cIDCustomer AS cIDCustomer_Invoice,
    O.xOrderType AS xOrderType_Order,
    O.cIDTrip AS cIDTrip_Order,
    O.cIDCustomer AS cIDCustomer_Order
FROM MC1_Invoice I WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN MC1_OrderInvoice OI WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON OI.cIDCompany = I.cIDCompany AND OI.cIDInvoice = I.cIDInvoice AND OI.cSerie = I.cSerie AND OI.cIDBranchInvoice = I.cIDBranchInvoice AND OI.mc1Enabled = 1
LEFT JOIN MC1_Order O WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON O.cIDCompany = OI.cIDCompany AND O.cIDOrder = OI.cIDOrder
WHERE I.cIDCompany = {cIDCompany}
  AND I.cIDInvoice = {cIDInvoice}
  AND I.cSerie = {cSerie}
  AND I.cIDBranchInvoice = {cIDBranchInvoice}

;WITH XMLNAMESPACES ('http://www.portalfiscal.inf.br/nfe' AS ns)
SELECT
    CAST(Det.value('(ns:prod/ns:cProd/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(50)') AS INT) AS cProd,
    Det.value('(ns:prod/ns:qCom/text())[1]', 'DECIMAL(18,4)') AS qCom,
    ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,4), Det.value('(ns:prod/ns:vFrete/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(50)')), 0.00) AS vFrete
FROM MC1_InvoiceResponseContent IRC WITH (NOLOCK)
CROSS APPLY (SELECT TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(IRC.cContent, 'XML convertido do JSON recebido: ', ''), CHARINDEX('<', REPLACE(IRC.cContent, 'XML convertido do JSON recebido: ', '')), LEN(IRC.cContent)) AS XML) AS XmlDoc) X
CROSS APPLY X.XmlDoc.nodes('/ns:NFe/ns:infNFe/ns:det') AS Itens(Det)
WHERE IRC.cIDCompany = {cIDCompany} AND IRC.cIDInvoice = {cIDInvoice} AND IRC.cSerie = {cSerie} AND IRC.cIDBranchInvoice = {cIDBranchInvoice} AND IRC.cContent IS NOT NULL AND IRC.cContent NOT LIKE '%error%'
GeneralDestinationRowSetSqlTemplate:
SELECT
    CAST(OI.cIDProduct AS INT) AS cProd,
    OI.nAmount AS qCom,
    OIE.nValueShip AS vFrete
FROM MC1_OrderItem OI WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN MC1_OrderInvoice OINV WITH (NOLOCK) ON OINV.cIDCompany = OI.cIDCompany AND OINV.cIDOrder = OI.cIDOrder AND OINV.mc1Enabled = 1
LEFT JOIN MC1_OrderItemExt OIE WITH (NOLOCK) ON OIE.cIDCompany = OI.cIDCompany AND OIE.cIDOrder = OI.cIDOrder AND OIE.nSeq = OI.nSeq
WHERE OI.mc1Enabled = 1 AND OINV.cIDCompany = {cIDCompany} AND OINV.cIDInvoice = {cIDInvoice} AND OINV.cSerie = {cSerie} AND OINV.cIDBranchInvoice = {cIDBranchInvoice}

PresenceRules.Name: Itens do XML não existentes no MC1_InvoiceItem
PresenceRules.SqlTemplate:
;WITH XMLNAMESPACES ('http://www.portalfiscal.inf.br/nfe' AS ns)
SELECT 'Produto ' + Det.value('(ns:prod/ns:cProd/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(50)') + ' do XML não existe na MC1_InvoiceItem' AS Mensagem
FROM MC1_InvoiceResponseContent IRC WITH (NOLOCK)
CROSS APPLY (SELECT TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(IRC.cContent, 'XML convertido do JSON recebido: ', ''), CHARINDEX('<', REPLACE(IRC.cContent, 'XML convertido do JSON recebido: ', '')), LEN(IRC.cContent)) AS XML) AS XmlDoc) X
CROSS APPLY X.XmlDoc.nodes('/ns:NFe/ns:infNFe/ns:det') AS Itens(Det)
WHERE IRC.cIDCompany = {cIDCompany} AND IRC.cIDInvoice = {cIDInvoice} AND IRC.cSerie = {cSerie} AND IRC.cIDBranchInvoice = {cIDBranchInvoice} AND IRC.cContent IS NOT NULL AND IRC.cContent NOT LIKE '%error%'
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM MC1_InvoiceItem II WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE II.cIDCompany = IRC.cIDCompany AND II.cIDInvoice = IRC.cIDInvoice AND II.cSerie = IRC.cSerie AND II.cIDBranchInvoice = IRC.cIDBranchInvoice
      AND II.mc1Enabled = 1 AND CAST(II.cIDProduct AS INT) = CAST(Det.value('(ns:prod/ns:cProd/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(50)') AS INT)
)
